mainEntity.name: Are there specific zoning rules for building an ADU in the Tampa Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Tampa Bay region, ADU construction must follow jurisdiction-specific rules established by Hillsborough, Pinellas, or neighboring counties and local municipalities. Local zoning codes dictate allowable unit sizes, mandatory property line setbacks, lot coverage maximums, and off-street parking rules. In addition, exterior building materials, stuccoing, roof tie-downs, and window ratings must meet Florida Building Code standards for hurricane wind resistance, making local zoning research an essential early step before finalizing plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, rules vary across Hillsborough and Pinellas jurisdictions regarding property setbacks, maximum unit dimensions, parking requirements, and Florida hurricane wind codes.
